'''Gan Basso''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who worked as a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] trailblazer in the early [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[25,053 BBY]]. A daredevil pilot who lived for the thrill of adventure, Basso was often the first to volunteer for dangerous [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] missions. Among Basso's discoveries was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. However, Basso's career and his life came to an end when his [[Gan Basso's starship|ship's]] hasty jump to hyperspace sent the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] into the [[Datar system's sun|sun]] of the [[Datar system/Legends|Datar system]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gan Basso was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
